name: Mario Paint instrument library for Bongo Planet

source.note: Extracted read-only from the retained user-supplied ROM. No ROM is bundled.

rights.status: Nintendo-derived local assets; no redistribution license established.

compatibility.models: glTF 2.0 GLB, one vertex-colored mesh per sprite; Three.js compatible.
compatibility.modelAxes: X right, Y up, Z outward from the Bongo Planet surface; origin at the center of the sprite canvas on the mounting plane.
compatibility.audio: Mono signed 16-bit little-endian PCM WAV, 32000 Hz; same PCM sample shape as src/audio/samples.ts.
compatibility.nativePitch: 13 original staff positions. Labels are positions on the native staff, not universal concert-pitch roots.
compatibility.productionCatalog: Separate library; IDs are not registered in production compositions or the main palette.

audioRendering.method: ROM SPC700 composer driver + Game_Music_Emu fast DSP; native gates, tuning, envelopes and channel fold-down; dry / echo disabled.
audioRendering.limitation: Isolated digital render; fast DSP approximates interpolation/timing. Not a full-console or analog recording.
audioRendering.trim: Native command latency removed; retain 16 leading frames and 320 trailing frames.

library.renderer: Game_Music_Emu fast SPC DSP; original SPC700 driver from supplied ROM; dry isolation; not a full-console recording
